$comment: Pinned Cliamp release vendored into Ari. Single source of truth for the bundled version: bump `version`, refresh the per-target sha256 from the release's checksums.txt, then run `node scripts/fetch-cliamp.mjs --all`. Binaries land in bin/<target>/ (gitignored) and ship inside the installer via electron-builder extraResources. Targets without a self-contained upstream binary intentionally have no entry and degrade to MusicUnavailable.
